desc.zh: 用位置与速度的完整状态，逐层寻找最短指令。
desc.en: Search complete position–speed states one command layer at a time.

complexity: O(2^D) time; O(2^D) space, conservative unit-cost bounds for minimum instruction count D

concepts.name: Race Car state-space BFS
concepts.description: Full position and signed speed pairs preserve future actions; unit-cost layers prove shortest arrival.
